newsitem.title: USA: Patriot set to buy Wyndham -Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Patriot set to buy Wyndham -Barron's.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Corp is expected to announce this week that it will purchase Wyndham Hotel Corp, in an agreement valued at more than one billion dollars, Barron's said Sunday.
Barron's said that as part of the deal, Patriot would also acquire up to 11 hotels owned by the Crow Family Trust of Dallas.

No one immediately responded to a request for comment left on Wyndham's voice mail at their office in Dallas, and no one answered the telephone at Patriot's Dallas corporate offices when efforts were made on Sunday to reach the firms for comment on the report.
Wyndham operates or franchises over 75 upscale hotels and resorts in the United States and the Caribbean, according to Standard and Poor's MarketScope service.
